summary: Grab Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing definitive agreements to acquire a controlling 60% equity interest in Neuroncredit Pte. Ltd. (Atome Financial), the digital financial services arm of Advance Intelligence Group, for $1.49 billion in cash. Consideration is all cash; the 60% stake implies a 100% equity value of roughly $2.48 billion, with no per-share price or premium disclosed. The transaction spans five Southeast Asian markets and is expected to complete by Q3 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Grab also agreed to acquire the remaining 40% approximately two years post-close, subject to separate approvals. Grab upgraded 2028 targets to $1.7 billion Adjusted EBITDA and 30%+ group revenue CAGR. Watch regulatory clearance timing across multiple jurisdictions and integration execution risk in consumer lending.
